sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Adam R. Stowers. It also documents that Stowers is a police seargent while his wife, Jamie L. Stowers, works as a records specialist for the American Fork Police Department.
In the Ben Schneider (Reckless Ben) case, Adamson’s recorded communications identify Stowers as receiving updates about the March 11 operation and plans for detainees at AFPD.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Police Sergeant Adam R. Stowers began working for the American Fork Police Department on August 3, 2009.

Sergeant Stowers is married to Jamie L. Stowers, who is employed by the American Fork Police Department as a records specialist. She served as Benjamin Schneider’s contact for records requests and handled redactions of body-camera footage released in connection with his case.

Their employment does not appear to violate the department’s nepotism policy because neither spouse is within the other’s direct chain of command. However, Adam Stowers’s leadership position within the department makes the relationship relevant when Jamie Stowers handles records concerning allegations against the department. This is not an allegation that either Adam or Jamie Stowers engaged in misconduct, but it raises a legitimate question about potential conflicts of interest and whether sensitive releases should receive independent review. See Policy 1025 of the American Fork Police Department Policy Manual.

contents.text_value: March 11, 2026: Adamson’s recorded texts and call identify Sgt. Stowers as receiving updates about the operation and the plans for detainees at AFPD. The recording does not establish Stowers’ own instructions.
